```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Repositories\Lda\JecmonKitOnlineRepository;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class JecmonKitOnlineRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        CarbonImmutable::setTestNow('2026-09-05 18:00:00');
        DB::shouldReceive('transaction')
            ->byDefault()
            ->andReturnUsing(static fn (callable $callback): mixed => $callback());
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        CarbonImmutable::setTestNow();

        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function publica_em_merges_de_vinte_e_cinco_e_remove_ausentes_na_mesma_transacao(): void
    {
        $mergesSnapshot = [];
        $mergeControle = null;
        DB::shouldReceive('affectingStatement')
            ->times(3)
            ->andReturnUsing(static function (string $sql, array $bindings) use (&$mergesSnapshot, &$mergeControle): int {
                if (str_contains($sql, 'MERGE INTO jecmon_kit_online_sync')) {
                    $mergeControle = compact('sql', 'bindings');
                } else {
                    $mergesSnapshot[] = compact('sql', 'bindings');
                }

                return 1;
            });
        DB::shouldReceive('delete')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static fn (string $sql, array $bindings): bool => str_contains($sql, 'DELETE FROM jecmon_kit_online')
                && $bindings[0] === 1219
                && is_string($bindings[1])
                && $bindings[1] !== '')
            ->andReturn(3);
        DB::shouldReceive('selectOne')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static fn (string $sql, array $bindings): bool => str_contains($sql, 'COUNT(*) AS total')
                && $bindings === [1219])
            ->andReturn((object) ['total' => 26]);

        $kits = array_map(fn (int $id): array => $this->kit($id), range(1, 26));
        $total = (new JecmonKitOnlineRepository)->publicar(1219, $kits);

        $this->assertSame(26, $total);
        $this->assertCount(2, $mergesSnapshot);
        $this->assertNotNull($mergeControle);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('JSON_TABLE', $mergesSnapshot[0]['sql']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE', $mergesSnapshot[0]['sql']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT', $mergesSnapshot[0]['sql']);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('tecnico', mb_strtolower($mergesSnapshot[0]['sql']));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('operador', mb_strtolower($mergesSnapshot[0]['sql']));
        $this->assertCount(25, json_decode($mergesSnapshot[0]['bindings'][0], true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
        $this->assertCount(1, json_decode($mergesSnapshot[1]['bindings'][0], true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
        $this->assertSame(1219, $mergeControle['bindings'][0]);
        $this->assertSame(26, $mergeControle['bindings'][3]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function snapshot_vazio_remove_anteriores_e_registra_sucesso_zero_sem_merge_de_item(): void
    {
        $sqls = [];
        DB::shouldReceive('affectingStatement')
            ->once()
            ->andReturnUsing(static function (string $sql, array $bindings) use (&$sqls): int {
                $sqls[] = compact('sql', 'bindings');

                return 1;
            });
        DB::shouldReceive('delete')->once()->andReturn(4);
        DB::shouldReceive('selectOne')->once()->andReturn((object) ['total' => 0]);

        $total = (new JecmonKitOnlineRepository)->publicar(1219, []);

        $this->assertSame(0, $total);
        $this->assertCount(1, $sqls);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('MERGE INTO jecmon_kit_online_sync', $sqls[0]['sql']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $sqls[0]['bindings'][3]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_contagem_oracle_divergente_antes_de_registrar_sucesso(): void
    {
        DB::shouldReceive('affectingStatement')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static fn (string $sql): bool => str_contains($sql, 'MERGE INTO jecmon_kit_online'))
            ->andReturn(1);
        DB::shouldReceive('delete')->once()->andReturn(0);
        DB::shouldReceive('selectOne')->once()->andReturn((object) ['total' => 0]);

        $this->expectException(RuntimeException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('contagem publicada');

        (new JecmonKitOnlineRepository)->publicar(1219, [$this->kit(1)]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function falha_no_merge_nao_remove_snapshot_anterior_nem_atualiza_controle(): void
    {
        DB::shouldReceive('affectingStatement')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static fn (string $sql): bool => str_contains($sql, 'MERGE INTO jecmon_kit_online'))
            ->andThrow(new RuntimeException('ORA-00001'));
        DB::shouldReceive('delete')->never();
        DB::shouldReceive('selectOne')->never();

        $this->expectException(RuntimeException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('ORA-00001');

        (new JecmonKitOnlineRepository)->publicar(1219, [$this->kit(1)]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_textos_maiores_que_as_colunas_oracle_antes_de_abrir_transacao(): void
    {
        DB::shouldReceive('transaction')->never();

        $kit = $this->kit(1);
        $kit['municipios'] = str_repeat('A', 1001);

        $this->expectException(RuntimeException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('texto acima do limite');

        (new JecmonKitOnlineRepository)->publicar(1219, [$kit]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function le_controle_e_kits_por_ids_com_json_table(): void
    {
        DB::shouldReceive('selectOne')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static fn (string $sql, array $bindings): bool => str_contains($sql, 'jecmon_kit_online_sync')
                && $bindings === [1219])
            ->andReturn((object) [
                'SYNC_RUN_ID' => 'run-1',
                'SINCRONIZADO_EM' => '2026-09-05 18:00:00.000000',
                'QTD_KITS' => 1,
            ]);
        DB::shouldReceive('select')
            ->once()
            ->withArgs(static function (string $sql, array $bindings): bool {
                return str_contains($sql, 'FROM jecmon_kit_online snapshot')
                    && ! str_contains($sql, 'online.kit_id')
                    && str_contains($sql, 'snapshot.sync_run_id = (')
                    && str_contains($sql, 'FROM jecmon_kit_online_sync controle')
                    && str_contains($sql, 'JSON_TABLE')
                    && $bindings[0] === 1219
                    && $bindings[1] === 1219
                    && json_decode($bindings[2], true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) === [10, 20];
            })
            ->andReturn([(object) ['ID' => 10, 'CERTIFICADO' => 'CERT-10']]);

        $repository = new JecmonKitOnlineRepository;

        $this->assertSame([
            'sync_run_id' => 'run-1',
            'sincronizado_em' => '2026-09-05 18:00:00.000000',
            'qtd_kits' => 1,
        ], $repository->ultimoSnapshot(1219));
        $this->assertSame([
            ['id' => 10, 'certificado' => 'CERT-10'],
        ], $repository->buscarPorIds(1219, [10, 20]));
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    private function kit(int $id): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $id,
            'homologacao_status' => 'FINALIZADA',
            'certificado' => "CERT-{$id}",
            'common_name' => "KIT {$id}",
            'bloqueado' => false,
            'uf' => 'AC',
            'ultimo_probe' => '2026-09-05T12:34:56-05:00',
            'fase' => 'OFICIAL',
            'turno' => '1',
            'conexao' => 7,
            'situacao_id' => 8,
            'situacao_numero' => 9,
            'ponto_id' => 10,
            'ponto_nome' => 'Ponto central',
            'zonas' => '1, 2',
            'municipios' => 'Rio Branco',
            'locais' => 'Local 1',
            'inicio_conexao' => '2026-09-05T10:00:00-05:00',
            'codigo_processo_eleitoral' => 1219,
        ];
    }
}
```
</TESTS_UNIT_JECMONKITONLINEREPOSITORYTEST_PHP>

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitOnlineSyncService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;
use Throwable;

class JecmonKitOnlineSyncCommandTest extends TestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function comando_forcado_executa_carga_inicial_e_exibe_contagens(): void
    {
        $service = new JecmonKitOnlineSyncServiceFake([
            'executado' => true,
            'paginas_consultadas' => 1,
            'origem_total' => 2,
            'destino_total' => 2,
        ]);
        $this->app->instance(JecmonKitOnlineSyncService::class, $service);

        $this->artisan('sync:jecmon:kits-online --force')
            ->expectsOutput('Kits conectados sincronizados: 2 de 2 em 1 página(s).')
            ->assertExitCode(0);

        $this->assertSame([true], $service->ignorarDesabilitado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function comando_informa_desabilitacao_sem_tratar_como_falha(): void
    {
        $service = new JecmonKitOnlineSyncServiceFake([
            'executado' => false,
            'motivo' => 'desabilitada',
            'paginas_consultadas' => 0,
            'origem_total' => 0,
            'destino_total' => 0,
        ]);
        $this->app->instance(JecmonKitOnlineSyncService::class, $service);

        $this->artisan('sync:jecmon:kits-online')
            ->expectsOutput('Sincronização de kits conectados desabilitada.')
            ->assertExitCode(0);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function comando_converte_falha_em_saida_generica_sem_expor_payload(): void
    {
        $service = new JecmonKitOnlineSyncServiceFake([], new RuntimeException('payload remoto sensível'));
        $this->app->instance(JecmonKitOnlineSyncService::class, $service);

        $this->artisan('sync:jecmon:kits-online --force')
            ->expectsOutput('Não foi possível sincronizar os kits conectados do JEC-MONITOR.')
            ->doesntExpectOutput('payload remoto sensível')
            ->assertExitCode(1);
    }
}

class JecmonKitOnlineSyncServiceFake extends JecmonKitOnlineSyncService
{
    /** @var list<bool> */
    public array $ignorarDesabilitado = [];

    /** @param array<string, int|bool|string> $resultado */
    public function __construct(private array $resultado, private ?Throwable $erro = null) {}

    public function sincronizar(bool $ignorarDesabilitado = false): array
    {
        $this->ignorarDesabilitado[] = $ignorarDesabilitado;
        if ($this->erro !== null) {
            throw $this->erro;
        }

        return $this->resultado;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Repositories\Lda\JecmonKitOnlineRepository;
use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitClient;
use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitOnlineSyncService;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Mockery;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class JecmonKitOnlineSyncServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Cache::flush();
        config([
            'services.jecmon.processo_eleitoral' => 1219,
            'services.jecmon.online_sync_enabled' => true,
        ]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function coleta_todas_as_paginas_e_publica_somente_o_snapshot_completo(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        $primeiraPagina = array_map(fn (int $id): array => $this->kit($id), range(1, 100));
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(0, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(0, 101, 2, $primeiraPagina)
        );
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(1, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(1, 101, 2, [$this->kit(101)])
        );
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->once()->with(1219, Mockery::on(
            static fn (array $kits): bool => array_column($kits, 'id') === range(1, 101)
        ))->andReturn(101);

        $resultado = (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();

        $this->assertSame([
            'executado' => true,
            'paginas_consultadas' => 2,
            'origem_total' => 101,
            'destino_total' => 101,
        ], $resultado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function com_mil_kits_consulta_dez_paginas_sequenciais_e_publica_todos(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        foreach (range(0, 9) as $pagina) {
            $inicio = ($pagina * 100) + 1;
            $itens = array_map(fn (int $id): array => $this->kit($id), range($inicio, $inicio + 99));
            $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with($pagina, 100)->andReturn(
                $this->pagina($pagina, 1000, 10, $itens)
            );
        }
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->once()->with(1219, Mockery::on(
            static fn (array $kits): bool => count($kits) === 1000
                && $kits[0]['id'] === 1
                && $kits[999]['id'] === 1000
        ))->andReturn(1000);

        $resultado = (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();

        $this->assertSame(10, $resultado['paginas_consultadas']);
        $this->assertSame(1000, $resultado['origem_total']);
        $this->assertSame(1000, $resultado['destino_total']);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function publica_snapshot_vazio_quando_a_api_confirma_zero_conectados(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->with(0, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(0, 0, 0, [])
        );
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->once()->with(1219, [])->andReturn(0);

        $resultado = (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();

        $this->assertTrue($resultado['executado']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $resultado['paginas_consultadas']);
        $this->assertSame(0, $resultado['destino_total']);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_mudanca_dos_totais_entre_paginas_sem_publicar(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        $primeiraPagina = array_map(fn (int $id): array => $this->kit($id), range(1, 100));
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(0, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(0, 101, 2, $primeiraPagina)
        );
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(1, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(1, 102, 2, [$this->kit(101), $this->kit(102)])
        );
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

        $this->expectException(RuntimeException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('totais da paginação mudaram');

        (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_tamanho_ou_total_de_paginas_incompativel_sem_publicar(): void
    {
        $cenarios = [
            'tamanho' => array_replace($this->pagina(0, 1, 1, [$this->kit(10)]), ['qtd' => 50]),
            'total de paginas' => $this->pagina(0, 1, 2, [$this->kit(10)]),
        ];

        foreach ($cenarios as $pagina) {
            $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
            $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
            $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->with(0, 100)->andReturn($pagina);
            $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

            try {
                (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();
                $this->fail('A paginação inconsistente deveria ser rejeitada.');
            } catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString('paginação', $exception->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_pagina_divergente_id_duplicado_e_contagem_incompleta(): void
    {
        $cenarios = [
            'pagina divergente' => [
                $this->pagina(1, 1, 1, [$this->kit(10)]),
                'página divergente',
            ],
            'id duplicado' => [
                $this->pagina(0, 2, 1, [$this->kit(10), $this->kit(10)]),
                'ID duplicado',
            ],
            'contagem incompleta' => [
                $this->pagina(0, 2, 1, [$this->kit(10)]),
                'quantidade divergente',
            ],
        ];

        foreach ($cenarios as [$pagina, $mensagem]) {
            $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
            $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
            $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->with(0, 100)->andReturn($pagina);
            $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

            try {
                (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();
                $this->fail('O snapshot inconsistente deveria ser rejeitado.');
            } catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString($mensagem, $exception->getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function nao_consulta_api_quando_outro_processo_possui_o_lock(): void
    {
        $lock = Cache::lock('jecmon:kits-online:sync:1219', 120);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());

        try {
            $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
            $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
            $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->never();
            $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

            $resultado = (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();

            $this->assertSame([
                'executado' => false,
                'motivo' => 'sobreposicao',
                'paginas_consultadas' => 0,
                'origem_total' => 0,
                'destino_total' => 0,
            ], $resultado);
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function falha_em_pagina_posterior_preserva_snapshot_e_proximo_ciclo_recomeca_do_zero(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        $primeiraPagina = array_map(fn (int $id): array => $this->kit($id), range(1, 100));
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(0, 100)->andReturn(
            $this->pagina(0, 101, 2, $primeiraPagina)
        );
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->once()->ordered()->with(1, 100)->andThrow(
            new RuntimeException('rate limit')
        );
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

        try {
            (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();
            $this->fail('A falha da segunda página deveria interromper a sincronização.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame('rate limit', $exception->getMessage());
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function feature_flag_desabilitada_nao_adquire_dados_remotos(): void
    {
        config(['services.jecmon.online_sync_enabled' => false]);
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $repository = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineRepository::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('listarOnline')->never();
        $repository->shouldReceive('publicar')->never();

        $resultado = (new JecmonKitOnlineSyncService($client, $repository))->sincronizar();

        $this->assertFalse($resultado['executado']);
        $this->assertSame('desabilitada', $resultado['motivo']);
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    private function kit(int $id): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $id,
            'codigo_processo_eleitoral' => 1219,
            'certificado' => "CERT-{$id}",
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $itens
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function pagina(int $pagina, int $totalElementos, int $totalPaginas, array $itens): array
    {
        return [
            'itens' => $itens,
            'pagina' => $pagina,
            'qtd' => 100,
            'total_elementos' => $totalElementos,
            'total_paginas' => $totalPaginas,
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Http\Controllers\Lda\KitController;
use App\Repositories\Lda\KitVinculoRepository;
use App\Repositories\Lda\LocalTransmissaoRepository;
use App\Repositories\LocaisVotacao\LocalVotacaoRepository;
use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitClient;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Mockery;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;

class KitControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Mockery::close();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function lista_paginada_respeita_escopo_e_indica_ocupacao_sem_revelar_destino(): void
    {
        session(['cod_zonas_permitidas' => [2], 'acesso_todas_zonas' => false]);
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('listar')->once()->with(1, 20)->andReturn([
            'itens' => [
                ['id' => 41, 'serial_kit' => 'A'],
                ['id' => 42, 'serial_kit' => 'B'],
                ['id' => 43, 'serial_kit' => 'C'],
            ],
            'pagina' => 1,
            'qtd' => 20,
            'total_elementos' => 3,
            'total_paginas' => 2,
        ]);
        $vinculos = Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class);
        $vinculos->shouldReceive('ocupacoesPorIds')->once()->with([41, 42, 43])->andReturn([
            41 => ['cod_objeto_local' => 'LV-2', 'local_transmissao_id' => null],
            42 => ['cod_objeto_local' => 'OUTRO', 'local_transmissao_id' => null],
        ]);
        $locais = Mockery::mock(LocalVotacaoRepository::class);
        $locais->shouldReceive('buscarNoEscopo')->once()->with('LV-2', [2], false)
            ->andReturn((object) ['cod_objeto' => 'LV-2']);

        $resposta = (new KitController(
            $client,
            $vinculos,
            $locais,
            Mockery::mock(LocalTransmissaoRepository::class)
        ))->buscar(Request::create('/lda/kits', 'GET', [
            'pagina' => 1,
            'qtd' => 20,
            'cod_objeto_local' => 'LV-2',
        ]));

        $itens = $resposta->getData(true)['itens'];
        $this->assertTrue($itens[0]['disponivel']);
        $this->assertTrue($itens[0]['vinculado_ao_destino']);
        $this->assertFalse($itens[1]['disponivel']);
        $this->assertFalse($itens[1]['vinculado_ao_destino']);
        $this->assertTrue($itens[2]['disponivel']);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('cod_objeto_local', $itens[1]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function detalha_certificados_dos_kits_selecionados_no_escopo_do_destino(): void
    {
        session(['cod_zonas_permitidas' => [2], 'acesso_todas_zonas' => false]);
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('detalharIds')->once()->with([41, 43])->andReturn([
            ['id' => 41, 'certificado' => 'CERT-41'],
            ['id' => 43, 'certificado' => 'CERT-43'],
        ]);
        $client->shouldNotReceive('listar');
        $locais = Mockery::mock(LocalVotacaoRepository::class);
        $locais->shouldReceive('buscarNoEscopo')->once()->with('LV-2', [2], false)
            ->andReturn((object) ['cod_objeto' => 'LV-2']);

        $resposta = (new KitController(
            $client,
            Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class),
            $locais,
            Mockery::mock(LocalTransmissaoRepository::class)
        ))->buscar(Request::create('/lda/kits', 'GET', [
            'detalhar' => 1,
            'kit_ids' => [41, 43],
            'cod_objeto_local' => 'LV-2',
        ]));

        $this->assertSame([
            'itens' => [
                ['id' => 41, 'certificado' => 'CERT-41'],
                ['id' => 43, 'certificado' => 'CERT-43'],
            ],
        ], $resposta->getData(true));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function indisponibilidade_remota_retorna_mensagem_sanitizada_e_preservacao(): void
    {
        session(['cod_zonas_permitidas' => [], 'acesso_todas_zonas' => true]);
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('listar')->once()->andThrow(new \RuntimeException('corpo técnico com token secreto'));
        $locais = Mockery::mock(LocalVotacaoRepository::class);
        $locais->shouldReceive('buscarNoEscopo')->once()->andReturn((object) ['cod_objeto' => 'LV-2']);

        $resposta = (new KitController(
            $client,
            Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class),
            $locais,
            Mockery::mock(LocalTransmissaoRepository::class)
        ))->buscar(Request::create('/lda/kits', 'GET', ['cod_objeto_local' => 'LV-2']));

        $this->assertSame(503, $resposta->getStatusCode());
        $mensagem = $resposta->getData(true)['mensagem'];
        $this->assertStringContainsString('preservados', $mensagem);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('token secreto', $mensagem);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Support\Lda\KitVinculoPayload;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;

class KitVinculoPayloadTest extends TestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function normaliza_ids_numericos_e_preserva_a_intencao_de_sincronizar(): void
    {
        $entrada = KitVinculoPayload::normalizarEntrada([' 42 ', 7], '1');
        $validado = Validator::make($entrada, KitVinculoPayload::regras())->validate();

        $this->assertTrue(KitVinculoPayload::deveSincronizar($validado));
        $this->assertSame([42, 7], KitVinculoPayload::idsSanitizados($validado));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_id_invalido_repetido_ou_nao_positivo(): void
    {
        foreach ([
            ['kit_ids' => ['abc'], 'sincronizar_kits_jec' => true],
            ['kit_ids' => [8, 8], 'sincronizar_kits_jec' => true],
            ['kit_ids' => [0], 'sincronizar_kits_jec' => true],
        ] as $entrada) {
            $validator = Validator::make(
                KitVinculoPayload::normalizarEntrada(
                    $entrada['kit_ids'],
                    $entrada['sincronizar_kits_jec']
                ),
                KitVinculoPayload::regras()
            );

            $this->assertTrue($validator->fails());
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function payload_ausente_mantem_vinculos_sem_solicitar_sincronizacao(): void
    {
        $entrada = KitVinculoPayload::normalizarEntrada(null, null);
        $validado = Validator::make($entrada, KitVinculoPayload::regras())->validate();

        $this->assertFalse(KitVinculoPayload::deveSincronizar($validado));
        $this->assertSame([], KitVinculoPayload::idsSanitizados($validado));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Repositories\Lda\KitVinculoRepository;
use App\Services\Auditoria\AuditLogService;
use DomainException;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Mockery;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;

class KitVinculoRepositoryTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::dropIfExists('jecmon_kit_vinculo');
        Schema::dropIfExists('lda');
        Schema::dropIfExists('local_transmissao');
        Schema::create('jecmon_kit_vinculo', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->increments('id');
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('kit_id')->unique();
            $table->string('cod_objeto_local', 18)->nullable();
            $table->unsignedInteger('local_transmissao_id')->nullable();
            $table->dateTime('dt_criacao');
            $table->dateTime('dt_atualizacao')->nullable();
        });
        Schema::create('lda', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->increments('id');
            $table->string('cod_objeto_local_votacao', 18)->nullable();
        });
        Schema::create('local_transmissao', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->increments('id');
            $table->string('cod_objeto_local_votacao', 18)->nullable();
        });
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Schema::dropIfExists('jecmon_kit_vinculo');
        Schema::dropIfExists('lda');
        Schema::dropIfExists('local_transmissao');
        Mockery::close();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function sincroniza_diferencas_auditadas_e_mapeia_codigo_logico(): void
    {
        $auditoria = Mockery::mock(AuditLogService::class);
        $auditoria->shouldReceive('registrarAcao')->times(3);
        $repository = new KitVinculoRepository($auditoria);

        $repository->sincronizarPorCodigo('LV-10', [101, 102]);
        $repository->sincronizarPorCodigo('LV-10', [102]);

        $this->assertSame([102], $repository->listarPorCodigo('LV-10'));
        $this->assertSame(['LV-10' => [102]], $repository->mapearPorCodigos(['LV-10']));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function rejeita_o_mesmo_kit_em_destinos_distintos_sem_expor_o_destino_atual(): void
    {
        DB::table('local_transmissao')->insert(['id' => 7, 'cod_objeto_local_votacao' => null]);
        $auditoria = Mockery::mock(AuditLogService::class);
        $auditoria->shouldReceive('registrarAcao')->once();
        $repository = new KitVinculoRepository($auditoria);
        $repository->sincronizarPorCodigo('LV-10', [101]);

        try {
            $repository->sincronizarPorLocalTransmissaoManual(7, [101]);
            $this->fail('O conflito global deveria ter sido rejeitado.');
        } catch (DomainException $exception) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('outro destino', $exception->getMessage());
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('LV-10', $exception->getMessage());
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function detecta_representante_compartilhado_entre_lda_e_local_derivado(): void
    {
        DB::table('lda')->insert(['id' => 2, 'cod_objeto_local_votacao' => 'LV-20']);
        DB::table('local_transmissao')->insert(['id' => 3, 'cod_objeto_local_votacao' => 'LV-20']);
        $repository = new KitVinculoRepository(Mockery::mock(AuditLogService::class));

        $this->assertTrue($repository->codigoPossuiRepresentante('LV-20', 2));
        DB::table('local_transmissao')->where('id', 3)->delete();
        $this->assertFalse($repository->codigoPossuiRepresentante('LV-20', 2));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitClient;
use App\Services\Lda\KitVinculoService;
use Mockery;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class KitVinculoServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Mockery::close();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function preserva_ids_atuais_quando_sincronizacao_nao_foi_solicitada(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldNotReceive('validarIds');

        $resultado = (new KitVinculoService($client))->prepararIds([30], [10, 20], false);

        $this->assertSame([10, 20], $resultado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function valida_remotamente_apenas_ids_novos(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('validarIds')->once()->with([30]);

        $resultado = (new KitVinculoService($client))->prepararIds([20, 30], [10, 20], true);

        $this->assertSame([20, 30], $resultado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function nao_consulta_api_quando_o_conjunto_permanece_igual(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldNotReceive('validarIds');

        $resultado = (new KitVinculoService($client))->prepararIds([20, 10], [10, 20], true);

        $this->assertSame([20, 10], $resultado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function consulta_certificados_em_lote_e_mapeia_pelo_id_do_kit(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('detalharIds')->once()->with([10, 20])->andReturn([
            ['id' => 10, 'certificado' => 'CERT-10'],
            ['id' => 20, 'certificado' => 'CERT-20'],
        ]);

        $resultado = (new KitVinculoService($client))->certificadosPorIds([20, 10, 20]);

        $this->assertSame([10 => 'CERT-10', 20 => 'CERT-20'], $resultado);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function consulta_de_certificados_indica_indisponibilidade_sem_bloquear_a_listagem(): void
    {
        $client = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitClient::class);
        $client->shouldReceive('detalharIds')->once()->with([10])->andThrow(
            new RuntimeException('JEC-MONITOR indisponível')
        );

        $resultado = (new KitVinculoService($client))->certificadosPorIds([10]);

        $this->assertNull($resultado);
    }
}
```
</TESTS_UNIT_KITVINCULOSERVICETEST_PHP>

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

class LdaConvocadosBuscaControllerTest extends TestCase

    {

        );
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Repositories\Lda\Contracts\CargoEquipeRepositoryInterface;
use App\Repositories\Lda\Contracts\EquipeRepositoryInterface;
use App\Services\Lda\LdaEquipeService;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Mockery;
use Tests\TestCase;

class LdaEquipeServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Mockery::close();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_sincronizar_rejeita_numero_de_inscricao_duplicado_no_mesmo_lda(): void
    {
        $equipes = Mockery::mock(EquipeRepositoryInterface::class);
        $equipes->shouldReceive('convocadoExistePorInscricao')
            ->once()
            ->with('000000000123')
            ->andReturnTrue();

        $cargos = Mockery::mock(CargoEquipeRepositoryInterface::class);
        $cargos->shouldReceive('buscar')->once()->with(5)->andReturn((object) ['id' => 5]);

        $service = new LdaEquipeService($equipes, $cargos);

        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);

        $service->sincronizar(8, [
            ['NUM_INSCRICAO' => '000000000123', 'CARGO_ID' => 5],
            ['NUM_INSCRICAO' => '000000000123', 'CARGO_ID' => 5],
        ]);
    }

    public function test_sincronizar_persiste_equipe_normalizada_por_vinculo_lda(): void
    {
        $equipes = Mockery::mock(EquipeRepositoryInterface::class);
        $equipes->shouldReceive('convocadoExistePorInscricao')
            ->once()
            ->with('000000000123')
            ->andReturnTrue();
        $equipes->shouldReceive('sincronizarPorVinculo')
            ->once()
            ->with('LDA', 8, [[
                'num_inscricao' => '000000000123',
                'cargo_id' => 5,
                'observacao' => null,
            ]]);

        $cargos = Mockery::mock(CargoEquipeRepositoryInterface::class);
        $cargos->shouldReceive('buscar')->once()->with(5)->andReturn((object) ['id' => 5]);

        $service = new LdaEquipeService($equipes, $cargos);

        $service->sincronizar(8, [
            ['NUM_INSCRICAO' => ' 000000000123 ', 'CARGO_ID' => '5'],
            ['NUM_INSCRICAO' => '', 'CARGO_ID' => ''],
        ]);

        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }
}
```
</TESTS_UNIT_LDAEQUIPESERVICETEST_PHP>

### 💻 Código Fonte PHP Completo:
```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Repositories\Lda\KitVinculoRepository;
use App\Services\Lda\JecmonKitOnlineConsultaService;
use App\Services\Lda\LdaMapaKitOnlineService;
use Mockery;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;

class LdaMapaKitOnlineServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Mockery::close();

        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function agrega_kits_online_por_codigo_sem_expor_ids(): void
    {
        $vinculos = Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class);
        $vinculos->shouldReceive('mapearPorCodigos')
            ->once()
            ->with(['LV-1', 'LV-2'])
            ->andReturn([
                'LV-1' => [30, 10, 20],
                'LV-2' => [40],
            ]);

        $snapshot = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineConsultaService::class);
        $snapshot->shouldReceive('buscarPorIds')
            ->once()
            ->with([10, 20, 30, 40])
            ->andReturn([
                'disponivel' => true,
                'sincronizado_em' => '2026-09-05T18:00:00+00:00',
                'itens' => [
                    ['id' => 10, 'certificado' => ' CERT-A '],
                    ['id' => 20, 'certificado' => 'CERT-A'],
                    ['id' => 30, 'certificado' => '   '],
                ],
            ]);

        $resultado = (new LdaMapaKitOnlineService($vinculos, $snapshot))
            ->statusPorCodigos([' LV-1 ', 'LV-2', 'LV-1', '']);

        $this->assertSame([
            'estado' => 'online',
            'total_vinculados' => 3,
            'total_online' => 3,
            'certificados_online' => ['CERT-A', 'Certificado indisponível'],
        ], $resultado['LV-1']);
        $this->assertSame([
            'estado' => 'offline',
            'total_vinculados' => 1,
            'total_online' => 0,
            'certificados_online' => [],
        ], $resultado['LV-2']);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('kit_id', json_encode($resultado, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function nao_consulta_snapshot_quando_nenhum_codigo_possui_vinculo(): void
    {
        $vinculos = Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class);
        $vinculos->shouldReceive('mapearPorCodigos')
            ->once()
            ->with(['LV-1', 'LV-2'])
            ->andReturn([]);

        $snapshot = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineConsultaService::class);
        $snapshot->shouldNotReceive('buscarPorIds');

        $resultado = (new LdaMapaKitOnlineService($vinculos, $snapshot))
            ->statusPorCodigos(['LV-1', 'LV-2']);

        $semVinculo = [
            'estado' => 'sem_vinculo',
            'total_vinculados' => 0,
            'total_online' => 0,
            'certificados_online' => [],
        ];
        $this->assertSame($semVinculo, $resultado['LV-1']);
        $this->assertSame($semVinculo, $resultado['LV-2']);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function snapshot_indisponivel_nao_e_interpretado_como_offline(): void
    {
        $vinculos = Mockery::mock(KitVinculoRepository::class);
        $vinculos->shouldReceive('mapearPorCodigos')
            ->once()
            ->with(['LV-1', 'LV-2'])
            ->andReturn(['LV-1' => [10, 20]]);

        $snapshot = Mockery::mock(JecmonKitOnlineConsultaService::class);
        $snapshot->shouldReceive('buscarPorIds')
            ->once()
            ->with([10, 20])
            ->andReturn([
                'disponivel' => false,
                'sincronizado_em' => '2026-09-05T17:58:00+00:00',
                'itens' => [],
            ]);

        $resultado = (new LdaMapaKitOnlineService($vinculos, $snapshot))
            ->statusPorCodigos(['LV-1', 'LV-2']);

        $this->assertSame([
            'estado' => 'indisponivel',
            'total_vinculados' => 2,
            'total_online' => 0,
            'certificados_online' => [],
        ], $resultado['LV-1']);
        $this->assertSame('sem_vinculo', $resultado['LV-2']['estado']);
    }
}
```
</TESTS_UNIT_LDAMAPAKITONLINESERVICETEST_PHP>

```php
    }

    public function test_presenter_normaliza_payload_sem_acessar_sessao_ou_banco(): void
    {
        $presenter = new LdaPainelPresenter();

        $normalizados = $presenter->normalizarTotais([
            (object) ['DESCRICAO' => ' Zona 1 ', 'TOTAL' => '3'],
            ['descricao' => 'Zona 2', 'total' => 4],
        ]);

        $this->assertSame([
            ['descricao' => 'Zona 1', 'total' => 3],
            ['descricao' => 'Zona 2', 'total' => 4],
        ], $normalizados);
        $this->assertSame(
            [['descricao' => 'Zona 2', 'total' => 4]],
            $presenter->filtrarPorZonas($normalizados, [(object) ['DESCRICAO' => 'zona 2']])
        );
    }

    public function test_composicao_restrita_repassa_escopo_e_soma_apenas_zonas_permitidas(): void
    {
        $repository = Mockery::mock(LocalDificilAcessoRepository::class);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarBganPorZona')->once()->with('10')->andReturn([
            (object) ['descricao' => 'Zona 1', 'total' => 2],
            (object) ['descricao' => 'Zona 9', 'total' => 7],
        ]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarTotalTabelaPorZona')->once()->with(null, '10', [1, 2], false)->andReturn(8);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarSecoesVinculadasTabelaPorZona')->once()->with(null, '10', [1, 2], false)->andReturn(20);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarBgan')->once()->with(1, '10')->andReturn([(object) ['total' => 2]]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarBgan')->once()->with(2, '10')->andReturn([(object) ['total' => 3]]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('resumirLdaPorZonaTabela')->once()->with(null, '10', [1, 2], false)->andReturn([]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('resumirLdaPorMunicipioTabela')->once()->with(null, '10', [1, 2], false)->andReturn([]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('contarInternetPorZona')->once()->with(0, '10')->andReturn([]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('resumoEnergia')->once()->with(0, '10')->andReturn([]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('resumoTransporte')->once()->with(0, '10')->andReturn([]);

        $painel = (new LdaPainelService($repository, new LdaPainelPresenter()))->montar(
            null,
            '10',
            [(object) ['DESCRICAO' => 'Zona 1']],
            [1, 2],
            false
        );

        $this->assertSame(5, $painel['bgan_total']);
        $this->assertSame([['descricao' => 'Zona 1', 'total' => 2]], $painel['bgan_por_zona']);
        $this->assertSame(8, $painel['total_locais']);
        $this->assertSame(20, $painel['total_secoes_vinculadas']);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Http\Controllers\Lda\LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoController;
use App\Repositories\Lda\LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRepository;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Mockery;
use Tests\TestCase;

class LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Mockery::close();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_index_retorna_view_com_recursos_ordenados(): void
    {
        $paginator = new LengthAwarePaginator(
            [(object) ['id' => 1, 'codigo' => 'URNAS', 'nome' => 'URNAS', 'ordem' => 20, 'ativo' => 1]],
            1,
            10,
            1,
            ['path' => '/tabelas-auxiliares/lda-recursos-logisticos']
        );

        $repository = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRepository::class);
        $repository->shouldReceive('listar')->once()->with(null, null)->andReturn($paginator);

        $controller = new LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoController($repository);
        $response = $controller->index(Request::create('/tabelas-auxiliares/lda-recursos-logisticos', 'GET'));

        $this->assertSame('tabelas-auxiliares.lda-recursos-logisticos.index', $response->name());
        $this->assertCount(1, $response->getData()['opcoes']);
    }

    public function test_form_retorna_view_com_registro_quando_id_for_informado(): void
    {
        $registro = (object) ['id' => 7, 'codigo' => 'STARLINK', 'nome' => 'STARLINK', 'ordem' => 30, 'ativo' => 1];
        $repository = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRepository::class);
        $repository->shouldReceive('buscar')->once()->with(7)->andReturn($registro);

        $controller = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoController::class, [$repository])->makePartial();
        $controller->shouldAllowMockingProtectedMethods();
        $controller->shouldReceive('autorizarAdmin')->once();
        $response = $controller->form(7);

        $this->assertSame('tabelas-auxiliares.lda-recursos-logisticos.form', $response->name());
        $this->assertSame($registro, $response->getData()['opcao']);
    }

    public function test_update_preserva_codigo_tecnico_urna_secao(): void
    {
        $repository = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRepository::class);
        $repository->shouldReceive('buscar')->once()->with(41)->andReturn((object) [
            'id' => 41,
            'codigo' => 'URNA_SECAO',
        ]);
        $repository->shouldReceive('atualizar')
            ->once()
            ->with(41, Mockery::on(static fn (array $dados): bool => $dados['codigo'] === 'URNA_SECAO'));

        $request = Mockery::mock(\App\Http\Requests\Lda\LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRequest::class);
        $request->shouldReceive('validated')->once()->andReturn([
            'codigo' => 'CODIGO_ADULTERADO',
            'nome' => 'Urnas de seção',
            'ordem' => 21,
            'peso_unitario_kg' => 10,
            'ativo' => false,
        ]);

        $controller = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoController::class, [$repository])->makePartial();
        $controller->shouldAllowMockingProtectedMethods();
        $controller->shouldReceive('autorizarAdmin')->once();
        $controller->update($request, 41);

        $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
    }

    public function test_destroy_bloqueia_exclusao_da_opcao_tecnica_urna_secao(): void
    {
        $repository = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoRepository::class);
        $repository->shouldReceive('buscar')->once()->with(41)->andReturn((object) [
            'id' => 41,
            'codigo' => 'URNA_SECAO',
        ]);
        $repository->shouldNotReceive('remover');

        $controller = Mockery::mock(LdaRecursoLogisticoOpcaoController::class, [$repository])->makePartial();
        $controller->shouldAllowMockingProtectedMethods();
        $controller->shouldReceive('autorizarAdmin')->once();

        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
        $controller->destroy(Request::create('/recurso/41', 'DELETE'), 41);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\TestCase;

class LdaTrajetoAlternativasMigrationTest extends TestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function migration_cria_pai_backfill_e_integridade_das_alternativas(): void
    {
        $conteudo = file_get_contents(database_path('migrations/2026_08_04_130000_create_lda_trajeto_alternativas.php'));

        $this->assertIsString($conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('CREATE TABLE lda_trajeto', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ordem_preferencia', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('descricao', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ALTER TABLE lda_trajeto_trecho ADD (trajeto_id', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('SELECT DISTINCT', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('UPDATE lda_trajeto_trecho', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('trajeto_id IS NULL', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('MODIFY (trajeto_id NOT NULL)', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('FOREIGN KEY (trajeto_id, cod_objeto_local, macroprojeto_id)', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(trajeto_id, ordem)', $conteudo);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Rollback bloqueado', $conteudo);
    }
}
```
</TESTS_UNIT_LDATRAJETOALTERNATIVASMIGRATIONTEST_PHP>
